# Comfy Muse Image 1.0- Image Edit

Edit an image with precision using Muse Image 1.0, following natural language instructions to alter specific elements while preserving the rest of the scene. Takes 2 input images and produces 1 edited output image. Ideal for product photography touch-ups, creative style transfers, and iterative visual refinement. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_meta_muse_image_image_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
